entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A human planeswalker with an affinity for angels who created Serra's Realm and was worshipped as a goddess.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: Heavenly plane Serra created, populated by angels, later collapsed into the Weatherlight's powerstone.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: Church on Dominaria founded to worship Serra.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: Archangel caretaker who became corrupted by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Wounded by Phyrexians, recovered in the Realm and later collapsed it.

entities.name: Brother Angus
entities.description: Man who saved Serra and built the Cathedral of Serra.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker guided by an echo of Serra.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire Serra and Feroz protected Ulgrotha from.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship Urza used to rescue refugees.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane where Serra lived with Feroz.

entities.name: Sursi
entities.description: Place on Dominaria where Serra was murdered.

events.summary: Phyrexians track Urza to the realm, taint it, and Serra abandons it, entrusting Radiant.
events.quote: entrusting the archangel Radiant as its caretaker in her absence

events.summary: Serra falls in love with Feroz and lives with him on Ulgrotha until he is accidentally killed.
events.quote: Feroz himself was accidentally killed before her eyes

events.summary: Serra is attacked in Sursi by a black-aligned planeswalker, wastes away, and sanctifies the land.
events.quote: She used her last strength to sanctify the land around Sursi.

events.summary: Radiant's corrupted angels slaughter the Realm's inhabitants.
events.quote: Radiant's corrupted angels becoming a terrible winged army

events.summary: Urza saves refugees and collapses the plane into the Weatherlight's powerstone.
events.quote: saved many Serran refugees before collapsing the plane

events.summary: An echo of Serra guides Elspeth, reawakening her as an archangel.
events.quote: she awoke to see an echo of Serra, who guided her to her destiny

relations.quote: eventually meeting and falling in love with another Planeswalker named Feroz
her legions persisted and were taken over by Radiant
